content:
opsbot: ALERT: Increased 5xxs and queue overflow on inference nodes. Affected endpoints: /v1/chat (timeouts), /v1/embeddings (long-tail latency), /v1/rerank (queued spikes). Paging: @alex (primary), @priya (secondary).

alex: on it. looking at the dashboards. chat latency rising at the 99th, embeddings p95 and p99 drifting up. Any recent deploys?

priya: No infra deploys in the last hour. Noticed a sudden traffic pattern: lots of tiny embeddings requests (<16 tokens) and concurrent rerank blasts from a handful of api keys. Could be batch-job misconfiguration.

tom: I've pulled raw headers: some clients are retrying aggressively. See header X-Retry-Attempt and burst source IPs.

maya: Immediate mitigation suggestions: 1) apply per-route minute quota for rerank (protect control-plane) 2) enable soft token-size throttling on rerank to penalize tiny low-value requests 3) lower per-connection concurrency for embeddings 4) add temporary per-tenant cap for top offenders.

infra-bot: Suggested commands (admin tooling):
```
# set rerank route to 6k/min globally
redwoodctl quotas update --route "/v1/rerank" --per_min 6000
# penalize small token calls (token-throttle multiplier)
redwoodctl routes update --route "/v1/rerank" --token_throttle 2.5 --min_tokens 1
# reduce embeddings concurrency per-connection
redwoodctl routes update --route "/v1/embeddings" --concurrency 2
```

alex: Applying rerank per_min now. Will watch queue depth.

opsbot: ACTION: redwoodctl quotas update --route "/v1/rerank" --per_min 6000 -> 200 OK.

priya: Queue depth reduced by ~60% for rerank within 45s. But chat timeouts still elevated. Chat traces show tail tokenization stalls: upstream lib causing CPU spikes.

product-bot: Notifying product about feature flags that affect chat: "context-merge" and "semantic-retry" currently on. Consider disabling semantic-retry to reduce extra downstream load.

maya: Toggle semantic-retry off for now. Also, set a per-tenant minute quota for the top offending key: key_x9z -> 1200/min across rerank+embeddings.

infra-bot: Commands: 
```
# disable semantic retry
redwoodctl feature toggle --name semantic-retry --state off
# set tenant combined quota
redwoodctl tenants update --tenant_id key_x9z_owner --quota '{"routes":["/v1/rerank","/v1/embeddings"],"per_min":1200}'
```

opsbot: Executed: semantic-retry -> OFF. Tenant cap applied to tenant key_x9z_owner -> 1200/min.

liam: Support ticket prep: support-bot, can you draft messages for the three top tenants flagged? Include mitigation steps and ETA for restoration.

support-bot: Drafts prepared for tenant-fjord, tenant-sprout, tenant-omega. tenant-fjord is enterprise; flagged for possible exception.

alex: Observability update: chat p99 down 40%, embeddings p95 down 25%. Rerank queue nominal. CPU for tokenization hosts still spiky but trending down. 5xxs decreased from 3.8% to 0.9%.

maya: Good. Next: longer-term route-specific actions we should track: - default per-route profiles (chat-latency, embeddings-batch-optimized, rerank-protected) - token-size-aware billing/quotas - approval workflow for tenant exceptions - rate limiting per-route per-origin IP to prevent retry storms.

priya: Creating INF ticket INF-2520: "Route quota profiles + token-size throttles" and assigning to infra+product. Link: https://issues.redwood.local/INF-2520

opsbot: NOTE: On-call handoff scheduled in 20m. Current owner: alex. Handoff to: priya. Please summarize mitigations for next shift.

alex: Handoff summary: 1) mitigations applied: rerank per_min -> 6000, semantic-retry off, tenant key_x9z capped to 1200/min, embeddings concurrency -> 2. 2) impact: error rate normalized to baseline, some customers degraded throughput; tenant-fjord eligible for exception; 3) follow-ups: INF-2520, audit logs for key_x9z activity, consider token-size throttling policy change.

support-bot: Notifying tenants now. tenant-fjord marked for high-priority CS contact.

maya: After-handoff tasks for infra: add a circuit-breaker rule on rerank to auto-shed low-priority traffic when queue depth > 80% capacity. Also add a rolling alert for tokenization CPU > 85%.

infra-bot: Filed follow-up infra task: INF-2521 "Circuit-breaker for rerank and tokenization CPU alert".

opsbot: INCIDENT STATUS: Stabilized. Incident remains open for monitoring for 1hr. If no regression, will mark resolved. :eyes:
